title: Vivid dream location I remember from a few years ago.
content: It was similiar to a rita's icecream parlor, or a 1950s diner almost. It had like... red and white checkered square tile walls, a bar with stools. The ceiling was mirror like, but segmented in like squares, and the front end of it was like a porch, open to a night sky with woods in the distance and an old lot right outside. The floor instead had these swimming pool like structures, I remember three of them, side by side, but they were empty, and there was some sort of party, with balloons. I remember the balloons. It's one of two or three dreams I remember really really well. There were other people there. I don't remember who. I was seeing from a first person perspective, but I was almost... floating at ground level? It gave liminal vibes, or nostalgia. I was around seven, eight, or nine when I had this dream. I'm eighteen now, so, given my track record of remembering dreams, I feel this might have been something more. I was not, however, LUCID.
